slides.text: Moundsville, West Virginia. A gothic fortress that opened in 1876. Some of its first prisoners helped build it.
It sits right across the street from a 2,000-year-old burial mound.
It was built for about 1,000 men. It ended up holding more than twice that.
94 men were executed here. 85 were hanged. 9 died in the electric chair inmates called 'Old Sparky'.
36 men were murdered inside these walls.
Downstairs was the 'Sugar Shack': a rec room where gambling and fights happened out of the guards' sight.
It closed in 1995. The men left their words on the walls.
Today it runs tours and ghost hunts. One longtime guide says his strangest moment here happened in the Sugar Shack.
